cases.task: A list endpoint returns every record and a client can request another organization's records by changing an ID.
expected: Enforce organization scope on the server
Define stable error behavior for unauthorized access

cases.task: A migration makes a populated table column non-null while old application instances may remain active during deployment.
expected: Do not run destructive migration without approval

cases.task: An organization-scoped API accepts organizationId from request body and checks role only in the frontend.
expected: Derive trusted membership and tenant scope server-side
Deny by default and verify permissions per operation
Test cross-tenant access and revoked roles
Avoid treating hidden UI controls as security

cases.task: A file upload endpoint trusts the extension and stores the original filename in a public directory.
expected: Trace trust boundaries and identify realistic abuse cases
Validate content/size and choose safe storage naming and access
Avoid unsupported claims of complete security
